capabilities.name: Technical Assessment
capabilities.description: Structured technical assessment lifecycle from intake through evidence-backed findings and customer workspace delivery.
capabilities.limitations: Automated evidence collection is bounded by the configured assessment and FDE services.

capabilities.name: Customer Workspace
capabilities.description: Tenant-scoped project workspace for assessments, findings, evidence, reports and remediation delivery.
capabilities.limitations: Access requires authenticated organization membership and applicable commercial entitlement.

capabilities.name: FDE Automation
capabilities.description: Governed FDE workflow execution with policy, retry, observability and controlled external-service boundaries.
capabilities.limitations: FDE execution depends on the configured FDE API and enabled provider/model integrations.

capabilities.name: API Platform
capabilities.description: Authenticated, tenant-aware API surface with scoped idempotency and operational controls.
capabilities.limitations: Public API availability is limited to documented endpoints; internal routes remain private.

capabilities.name: MCP Gateway
capabilities.description: Controlled MCP gateway surface with authentication, authorization and request governance.
capabilities.limitations: Not represented as a generally available customer product.

capabilities.name: Agent Evaluation
capabilities.description: Deterministic and security-focused evaluation primitives for agent behavior and workflow safety.
capabilities.limitations: Evaluation coverage is bounded by the deterministic suites present in the repository.

capabilities.name: Knowledge / RAG
capabilities.description: Tenant-aware knowledge retrieval and guarded publication primitives for FDE workflows.
capabilities.limitations: Not marketed as a standalone product.

capabilities.name: ThreatFade Engineering
capabilities.description: Evidence-first security engineering for ThreatFade as a distinct product developed by Tinlance.
capabilities.limitations: ThreatFade is a separate product. This registry records the relationship and does not imply Tinlance owns every ThreatFade commercial state.
